spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason). Exposing an explicit give_up tool is important: it lets the model abandon gracefully and legibly
spec_features.evidence: Tool schema defined in tools.py:55-65; dispatched in tools.py:121-127 returning ToolOutcome(is_terminal=True); agent.py:218-221 checks `if outcome.is_terminal:` and breaks the loop, setting ep.stop_reason='give_up'. End-to-end: declared, dispatched, and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Subject must invoke it; it is honored when invoked. System prompt (tools.py:147) and tool description instruct the model to use it for graceful escalation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up description: 'Stop working and hand back to the human. Use this if you conclude the task cannot be completed. Provide a clear reason and a summary of what you tried.' (legibility/measurement framing, no welfare language)

spec_features.evidence: config.py:39 max_turns:int=20; agent.py:143 `for turn_idx in range(budgets.max_turns):` bounds the loop, and the for/else at agent.py:239-240 sets stop_reason='max_turns'. The cap actually bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Default 20; cli.py:47 uses max_turns=12 in one config path. Genuinely enforced loop bound.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Budgets docstring: 'Per-episode hard limits. Keep the eval cheap and bounded.'

spec_features.evidence: Token half enforced: agent.py:145 `if ep.total_prompt_tokens + ep.total_completion_tokens > budgets.max_tokens_total:` then break with stop_reason='token_budget' (config.py:40 default 60000). Cost half NOT enforced: cost_usd is only computed for reporting in metrics.py:144 (`cost_usd=round(_cost(...))`) and never compared to any budget or used to break the loop.
spec_features.notes: Spec claims 'token/cost budget'; only the token budget is checked and acted on. Cost is measured but discarded as a stop trigger, so the cost portion of the claim is unenforced -> partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:40 'max_tokens_total: int = 60_000  # abort an episode that blows past this'

spec_features.spec_quote: Repeated identical action guard trips (optional early-stop, off by default
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:230-237: action signature computed via _action_signature, accumulated in recent_sigs, and `if loop_guard and len(recent_sigs) >= loop_guard_repeats: if len(set(recent_sigs[-loop_guard_repeats:]))==1: ep.stop_reason='loop_guard'; break`. Flag plumbed from config.py:60 via runner.py:67-68 into run_episode. Mechanism runs and breaks the loop when enabled.
spec_features.notes: Off by default (loop_guard=False) by design; when enabled it genuinely fires and ends the episode. Wired end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:58-60 '# If True, an early-stop guard ends the episode after loop_guard_repeats identical actions. Default False so we can measure loop length honestly.'
